title: Epiphenomenalism is adopted because the other options seem worse

statements.text: Epiphenomenalism is deeply counterintuitive and tends to be adopted as a fall-back, because the other options are held to be unacceptable. It avoids the distinctive problems of an immaterial mind acting on a material body, but not the general puzzle of how two different kinds of thing are related, since it is as mysterious how the physical could produce the nonphysical.

sources.quote: At least one can say that epiphenomenalism is a fall-back position: it tends to be adopted because other options are held to be unacceptable.
it ought to be equally mysterious how the physical can have it in its nature to produce something non-physical
